channel.title: Arun Kumar — Journalistic Archive
channel.description: Official archive of Arun Kumar (Senior Assistant Editor, Hindustan Times Patna Bureau) covering Bihar politics, higher education, Patna High Court jurisprudence, and governance.

item.title: No student will 'fail' in Class 10, 12: Bihar govt to replace it with 'Eligible for Skill Training' | Hindustan Times
item.description: Bihar will replace 'Fail' on Class 10 and 12 marksheets with 'Eligible for Skill Training', allowing students to pursue vocational training
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Chancellor's secretariat asks varsities to clear salary/pension backlogs by July 20 | Hindustan Times
item.description: The Chancellor's secretariat has asked all varsities to clear salaries to university teachers and employees, and pension and retirement benefits to retired ones by July 20 and submit status reports in the prescribed format, officials said on Sunday. Additional chief secretary (ACS) to the Governor, Dipak Kumar Singh, sent a letter to VCs in this regard.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: PK to contest Bankipur bypoll | Hindustan Times
item.description: Jan Suraaj Party announced Prashant Kishor as its candidate for Bankipur bypoll on July 30, aiming for political change in Bihar post-2025 elections.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Crucial Bankipur bypoll on July 30; to be test for BJP chief Nabin, Bihar CM Samrat on BJP home turf | Hindustan Times
item.description: The ECI announced by-elections for the Bankipur seat on July 30, with counting on August 3, amidst competition from RJD and Jan Suraaj Party.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Bihar Lok Bhawan extends application deadline for VCs, P-VCs for larger pool | Hindustan Times
item.description: Bihar Governor's secretariat extends application deadline for vice chancellors and pro-vice chancellors to July 21, aiming for significant reforms in higher education.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: SC judge inaugurates interdisciplinary research unit at CNLU | Hindustan Times
item.description: Chanakya National Law University (CNLU), Patna, in collaboration with GIGA Innovations Technologies Pvt.Ltd., on Wednesday inaugurated the Cyber Security and Data Protection Compliance Research Unit (CS-DPCRU), a pioneering initiative dedicated to advancing research, policy development, capacity building, and industry collaboration in the fields of cyber security, data protection, privacy, and emerging technologies.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Bihar misses July 1 deadline for 211 new colleges | Hindustan Times
item.description: The ambitious scheme announced the NDA government is a part of Saat Nischay-3 flagship programme and aims to expand higher education to every block of the state
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Bihar starts training for state officials at ISTM to tone up administration | Hindustan Times
item.description: Bihar government trains administrative officers at ISTM to ensure compliance with service rules, aiming to reduce judicial scrutiny of disciplinary actions.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: RJD MP accuses Bihar Police's SVU of shielding 8 IAS officers in multi-crore tender fraud | Hindustan Times
item.description: Sudhakar Singh alleged that while second rung officials were being arrested, the senior IAS officials had been let off despite ED's clear indications at whose behest junior officials operated without fear
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: PM lauds Nalanda University's initiative to protect ancient tradition in line with tech era | Hindustan Times
item.description: Prime Minister remarked that Nalanda's knowledge tradition, which flourished thousands of years ago, is once again guiding India's future in a renewed form
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Bihar to have new Act to govern state varsities | Hindustan Times
item.description: The new law will incorporate best practices adopted by 15 other states and also key features of similar acts prevalent there
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Patna HC criticises 'autocratic action' of state on decades old land ownership | Hindustan Times
item.description: Hearing his civil writ petition, a single-judge bench of Justice Sourendra Pandey ordered the local administration to immediately resume issuing rent receipts to the petitioner
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Teachers' shortage prompts Bihar govt to widen hiring ambit for degree colleges | Hindustan Times
item.description: Education department secretary Rajiv Raushan wrote to all the district education officers (DEOs) for details of eligible Class 9-10 school teachers after verification for deputation in degree colleges. Earlier, it was only for Class 11-12.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: JD(U) won't disintegrate like TMC, UBT: Sanjay Jha | Hindustan Times
item.description: Jha said that at the National Council meeting on Sunday, Nitish Kumar himself indicated that he would devote more time to the organisation to ensure even better performance in the future and facilitate a smooth generational transition.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: With Nitish legacy, JD-U has no challenges, to contest UP polls: Sanjay Kumar Jha | Hindustan Times
item.description: JD-U working president Sanjay Kumar Jha said that Kumar himself said that he will devote more time to the organisation with an eye on the 2029 Lok Sabha election and 2030 Assembly elections
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: JD(U) pledges to follow Nitish, promote Nishant | Hindustan Times
item.description: The party also appreciated centre's continued help in development of Bihar and congratulated the Samrat government for being committed to taking forward Nitish's legacy
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Bihar governor issues strict guidelines to VCs to check arbitrary transfers | Hindustan Times
item.description: The guidelines have been issued in order to ensure transparency, uniformity, and academic continuity.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: SD Sanjay appointed new Advocate General of Bihar | Hindustan Times
item.description: A cabinet notification to this effect was issued by Bihar's law department on Thursday. He took charge on Thursday itself.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Ahead of teachers' transfer policy, Samrat says no excuses after choice posting | Hindustan Times
item.description: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary on Tuesday said that the government was trying to resolve the vexed issue of teachers' transfer with a policy that would favour all, but the teachers would also be required to deliver what is expected of them - quality education in schools.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Bihar AG PK Shahi resigns, successor may be named today | Hindustan Times
item.description: Bihar's Advocate General PK Shahi resigned, effective Monday, following convention. His successor, experienced in both Supreme Court and Patna High Court, will be notified soon.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Bihar govt releases ₹998-cr for March to May salary, pension to varsities and colleges | Hindustan Times
item.description: The funds have been released on the basis of interim approval of the universities' budget and the concerned authorities have to submit utilisation certificates within a month, says the government letter.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: After docs' pvt practice ban, Bihar bars teachers from tuition, coaching | Hindustan Times
item.description: The education department has warned violating teachers of strict disciplinary action for breaching the code of conduct if they were found engaged in private coaching and tuition
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: NITI Aayog meet: Bihar CM seeks funds, string of institutes from Centre | Hindustan Times
item.description: Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary requests ₹18,000 crore from the Centre for water programs, institutes, and support for upcoming national events and development projects.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Bihar's coaching chaos stems from 'feeble' implementation of 2010 Act | Hindustan Times
item.description: Despite strict provisions, coaching centres remained unbridled and made hay, with the government responding only with knee-jerk reaction to problems cropping up every now and then
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Bihar Governor calls for strict compliance with fire safety norms, urges greater awareness | Hindustan Times
item.description: The Governor, who was earlier member of the National Disaster a management Authority (NDMA), directed to organise a seminar at Bihar Lok Bhawan with the aim of increasing public awareness towards fire safety.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: After a long gap, Governor initiates process for appointment of 14 Pro-VCs in Bihar | Hindustan Times
item.description: This means, there will be 24 appointments made for the highest academic posts in the state universities in the coming months by Governor Lt Gen (Rtd) Syed Ata Hasnain. For the last few years, no appointment had been made to the post of Pro-VCs in Bihar.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Samrat bats for Centre and state coordination for Bihar growth in Delhi | Hindustan Times
item.description: the CM said that Bihar has made remarkable progress in the fields of infrastructure, power, connectivity and rural development, but it is necessary to work together continuously to give the state a new identity at the global level
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Amid raging debate over 3-language policy, CUSB to award multilingualism | Hindustan Times
item.description: VC KN Singh said that at a time when implementation of 3-Language Policy of the ministry of education, government of India is a much debated issue, multilingualism should not be seen as a handicap, but a welcome requirement
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Bihar guv cancels old advts for appointment of four VCs midway, to start fresh process | Hindustan Times
item.description: The advertisements would be issued afresh with fresh guidelines for wider publicity to give opportunities to more capable candidates who could pull the universities out of the rut, a Lok Bhavan official said
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Samrat discusses higher education issues with Governor ahead of new deptt review | Hindustan Times
item.description: The issue of unending controversies on the ongoing recruitment of assistant professors by the Bihar State University Service Commission (BSUSC) also figured during the discussions between the Governor and the CM.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)
